The Celtics defeated the Bulls, 125-111 tonight in Boston. Payton Pritchard finished with a team-high 30 points along with 3 rebounds and 3 assists for the Celtics, while Jayson Tatum tallied 26 points, 7 rebounds and 7 assists in the game. Caleb Wilson recorded 23 points, 6 three pointers and 5 rebounds. The Celtics improve their record to 4-1 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 1-5 for the season.
